The failure indicates that the method is not treating image inputs appropriately, leading to a mismatch between expected and actual form data.

However, it appears that the current implementation is missing logic to handle image inputs specifically. Consequently, when the test asserts the form data, it expects both text and image inputs to be present, but only the text input is found in the response.
